eoi.title: Partner expression of interest
eoi.subtitle: Apply for State Master or Local BDE partnership territory.
eoi.pageSubtitle: Administrative & Revenue Partner Program — Australian Road Freight Network
eoi.introBody: CLOX shifts the high-markup traditional freight broker paradigm into fully automated code. We isolate regional operations through a multi-tier administration framework, incentivizing active ecosystem partners with direct automated gross revenue splits managed natively via programmatic escrow settlements.
eoi.stateMasterDesc: Responsible for regional compliance auditing, carrier verification safety nets (ABN, Insurances, RWCs), legislative alignment, and regional transport corridor management.
eoi.localBdeTitle: Local BDE Admin / Business Development Manager (Local Tier)
eoi.localBdeDesc: Responsible for regional sales generation, local shipper/carrier onboarding acquisition pipelines, lane density development, and local relationship management.
eoi.networkExperience: Briefly outline your existing network, industry footprint, or experience within the Australian logistics ecosystem
eoi.executionStrategy: Specify your target execution strategy (e.g., local shipper acquisition channels, corporate sender procurement networks, fleet onboarding resources)
eoi.tableStateMandate: Regional compliance audits, verify heavy vehicle RWC & ABN safety lockouts, dispute management intervention.
eoi.tableLocalMandate: Customer liquidity acquisition, onboard regional carrier owner-operators, accelerate lane velocity.
eoi.settlementNote: *Note: As per the CLOX Settlement Logic, all administrative distributions are automatically generated over a rolling 14-day cycle and distributed via Monoova NPP splits, net of standardized platform management fees and corporate marketing cost recovery allocations.
eoi.declaration: By executing this Expression of Interest (EOI), the applicant confirms that all information provided is true, accurate, and current. The applicant acknowledges that submission of this form does not guarantee admission into the CLOX administrative network, and that final selection is contingent upon strict KYB screening, manual executive board review, and execution of the formal CLOX Master Administration Agreement and non-compete frameworks. All discussions and proprietary operational disclosures remain strictly bound by the terms of the active CLOX Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).
eoi.successBody: We will be in touch shortly.

privacy.whoBody: CLOX Logistics (Displace Global Enterprises Pty Ltd) collects pre-launch interest information via clox.com.au.
privacy.whatBody: Depending on the form: name/company, email, phone, ABN/ACN, location, role preferences, and free-text notes needed to evaluate registry, partner EOI, or investor pre-qualification.
privacy.purposeBody: Data is used only to evaluate pre-launch interest and contact applicants. Retention is limited to the pre-launch and onboarding period unless a longer period is required by law.
privacy.contactBody: Privacy requests: support@clox.com.au. We do not sell personal information to third parties.
